roadmap.title: Play the main story and the World War I simulation
roadmap.description: Work through Memory Sequences 1-9 in order and enter the World War I rift once it opens, clearing its Spy Hunts and Hideouts. Grab comfortable optional objectives as you go; anything missed can be replayed later. Pick up Friends at My Back and The War at Home when their conditions unlock.

roadmap.title: Complete London
roadmap.description: Finish everything the base game counts toward 100%: conquer all seven boroughs and their activities, max associate loyalty, gather every collectible, learn all Jacob and Evie skills, buy all gang upgrades, earn ten perks and clear the optional objectives in every memory. Mop up the combat and carriage counters while roaming.

roadmap.title: Jack the Ripper
roadmap.description: Play the Jack the Ripper DLC: finish the story and its optional objectives, clear the associate activities, and collect every Chest, Locked Chest, Helix Glitch and Historical Poster for 100% synchronization. Use the fear tools for the DLC's kill counters.

achievements.description: Complete Memory Sequence 1.
achievements.summary: Finish Memory Sequence 1.

steps.text: Play through the memories of @mechanic{Memory Sequence 1} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete Memory Sequence 2.
achievements.summary: Finish Memory Sequence 2.

steps.text: Play through the memories of @mechanic{Memory Sequence 2} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete Memory Sequence 3.
achievements.summary: Finish Memory Sequence 3.

steps.text: Play through the memories of @mechanic{Memory Sequence 3} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete Memory Sequence 4.
achievements.summary: Finish Memory Sequence 4.

steps.text: Play through the memories of @mechanic{Memory Sequence 4} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete Memory Sequence 5.
achievements.summary: Finish Memory Sequence 5.

steps.text: Play through the memories of @mechanic{Memory Sequence 5} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete Memory Sequence 6.
achievements.summary: Finish Memory Sequence 6.

steps.text: Play through the memories of @mechanic{Memory Sequence 6} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete Memory Sequence 7.
achievements.summary: Finish Memory Sequence 7.

steps.text: Play through the memories of @mechanic{Memory Sequence 7} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete Memory Sequence 8.
achievements.summary: Finish Memory Sequence 8.

guide.context: Sequence 8 stays locked until you conquer any 3 of London's 7 boroughs; it does not open straight after Sequence 7.

steps.text: Conquer three boroughs, then play through the memories of @mechanic{Memory Sequence 8} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete Memory Sequence 9.
achievements.summary: Finish Memory Sequence 9.

steps.text: Play through the memories of @mechanic{Memory Sequence 9} to the end.

achievements.description: Recruit a gang of 5 allies.
achievements.summary: Recruit five Rook allies at the same time.

guide.context: Recruiting five at once needs the @mechanic{Leadership III} skill and the @item{Cavalry Call} Gang Upgrade.

steps.text: Unlock @mechanic{Leadership III} and buy @item{Cavalry Call}, then call a @item{cart} to summon five @npc{Rooks} to your side at once.

achievements.description: Complete the World War I simulation.
achievements.summary: Finish the World War I simulation.

guide.context: The rift opens on the far right end of the River Thames once Sequence 6 starts, and fast travel inside unlocks after your first visit.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{World War I} rift on the far right end of @loc{the River Thames}.
Clear the two @mechanic{Spy Hunts} and three @mechanic{Spy Hideouts}, then finish the @mechanic{Master Spy Hunt}.

achievements.description: Sample every beer brand in London.
achievements.summary: Sample every beer brand available in London.

guide.context: Vendors sell a treasure map for the beer bottles, including the black market merchant on your train.

steps.text: Buy the @item{beer bottle} treasure map from a vendor.
Collect every bottle marked on the map to sample all of London's beer brands.

achievements.description: Kick fifty enemies off of trains.
achievements.summary: Kick 50 enemies off trains.

guide.context: Only the finishing kick at a train's edge counts; stealth drops and knife throws do not.

steps.text: Replay @loc{A Spanner In The Works} and fight the Blighters on the train, or @loc{Runaway Train} on the roof of your own train.
steps.note: The Last Maharaja Memory 6, Off The Rails, puts close to 15 Templars on your train if you own that DLC.

steps.text: Finish enemies at the train's edge so Jacob kicks them off, then reload the checkpoint and repeat until 50 are kicked off.

achievements.description: Secure three Gang Strongholds and complete their optional constraints.
achievements.summary: Take three Gang Strongholds with all optional constraints completed.

steps.text: Clear a @loc{Gang Stronghold} while completing its optional constraints, then repeat at two more strongholds.

achievements.description: Win three different Fight Clubs.
achievements.summary: Win three different Fight Clubs.

steps.text: Win a @mechanic{Fight Club} by fighting until the game declares you the winner, then win two more at different clubs.
steps.note: The easiest clubs are in @loc{Whitechapel}, @loc{City of London} and @loc{Lambeth}.

achievements.description: Finish first in 3 different Street Races.
achievements.summary: Take first place in three different Street Races.

guide.context: Only Lap Races and A to B Races count; Exotic Races and Triathlons do not.

steps.text: Finish first in a @mechanic{Lap Race} or @mechanic{A to B Race}, then do the same in two other races.

achievements.description: Complete ten Raids of any type with Jacob or Evie.
achievements.summary: Complete 10 Raids with Jacob or Evie.

guide.context: Only Boat Raids, Train Robberies and Cargo Hijacks count; Smuggler's Boats and Cargo Escorts do not.

steps.text: Complete 10 counted raids: @mechanic{Boat Raids}, @mechanic{Train Robberies} or @mechanic{Cargo Hijacks}.

achievements.description: Bring three Bounty targets back alive.
achievements.summary: Return three Bounty targets to custody alive.

steps.text: Knock out a @mechanic{Bounty target} and deliver them alive, then repeat for two more targets.

achievements.description: Complete three Templar Hunts and their challenges.
achievements.summary: Complete three Templar Hunts including their challenges.

steps.text: Finish a @mechanic{Templar Hunt} and its challenges, then repeat for two more hunts.

achievements.description: Complete five Child Liberation memories.
achievements.summary: Complete five Child Liberation missions.

steps.text: Clear five @mechanic{Child Liberation} missions around London.

achievements.description: Successfully escort ten friendly cargo shipments.
achievements.summary: Escort 10 friendly cargo shipments successfully.

guide.context: Cargo Escorts have no fixed spawn; they appear randomly near you as you travel, so take every one you see.

steps.text: Complete each @mechanic{Cargo Escort} that appears near you until 10 shipments are escorted safely.

achievements.description: Unlock all of the Secrets of London.
achievements.summary: Find and retrieve all 32 Secrets of London.

guide.context: The 32 music boxes are spread across every borough and no vendor sells a map, so listen for their music and use Eagle Vision to spot them.

steps.text: Collect the 32 @item{Secrets of London} music boxes hidden around London.
Return to @loc{Reuge's Vault} and pull every lever to unlock the achievement and the @item{Aegis} outfit.

achievements.description: Reach Loyalty level 1 with all Associates.
achievements.summary: Reach Loyalty level 1 with every Associate.

guide.context: The Associates are @npc{Henry Green}, @npc{Frederick Abberline}, @npc{Clara O'Dea}, @npc{Robert Topping}, @npc{Ned Wynert} and @npc{Winston Churchill}, whose loyalty comes from the World War I simulation.

steps.text: Complete activities for each Associate until all six reach Loyalty level 1.

achievements.description: Reach maximum Loyalty with any Associate.
achievements.summary: Reach maximum Loyalty with one Associate.

guide.context: Loyalty caps at level 5 and grows only from that Associate's own activities.

steps.text: Complete one Associate's activities until their Loyalty reaches level 5.
For @npc{Ned Wynert}, clear every fixed-spawn Cargo Hijack first, then repeat Boat Raids and Smuggler's Boats.
For @npc{Robert Topping}, replay races you did not win and Fight Clubs you did not reach the final round of.

achievements.description: Kill five enemies from within the same haystack.
achievements.summary: Kill five enemies from inside one haystack.

steps.text: Replay @loc{Sequence 6, Memory 2} and drop into the haystack beside the middle weapon crate.
Assassinate the two guards next to the haystack and the guard who walks past, without being seen.
Whistle to draw the two patrolling enemies within reach and kill them from inside the haystack.

achievements.description: Conquer all the boroughs in London
achievements.summary: Conquer every borough in London.

guide.context: A borough's conquest mission only becomes available once its activities and supporter tasks are finished.

steps.text: Finish a borough's activities and run its conquest mission, then repeat until all seven boroughs are conquered.

achievements.description: Acquire ten Perks.
achievements.summary: Earn 10 Perks.

guide.context: You only need 10 of the available Perks; Fight Clubs are a quick source of the multi-kill ones.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Perk} challenges as you play until 10 Perks are unlocked.

achievements.description: Acquire all of the Gang Upgrades.
achievements.summary: Buy every Gang Upgrade.

guide.context: @mechanic{City Takeover} cuts the price of all other upgrades, and the income upgrades fund the rest.

steps.text: Befriend @npc{Ned Wynert} and buy @mechanic{City Takeover} in the Swindler skill tree.
Buy the passive income upgrades further down the Swindler tree.
Purchase every remaining @mechanic{Gang Upgrade}.

achievements.description: Craft a Level 10 Item.
achievements.summary: Craft any Level 10 item.

guide.context: You need a Level 10 schematic and its unique material; locked chests supply both, and some side quests also give unique materials.

steps.text: Collect a Level 10 schematic and its unique material from locked chests or side quests.
steps.note: Quick option: the @item{Aegis Cloak} schematic is the reward for Sequence 9 Memory 4, and @item{Golden Spider Silk} sits in a locked chest in @loc{the Strand}.

steps.text: Craft the item from the gear crafting menu.

achievements.description: Learn every Fight Skill as Jacob.
achievements.summary: Unlock every Fight Skill as Jacob.

steps.text: Spend Jacob's skill points in the Fight tree until every skill is learned.

achievements.description: Learn every Stealth Skill as Evie.
achievements.summary: Unlock every Stealth Skill as Evie.

steps.text: Spend Evie's skill points in the Stealth tree until every skill is learned.

achievements.description: Reach Level 10.
achievements.summary: Reach character level 10.

guide.context: The Gold Edition's permanent 10% XP boost speeds this up.

steps.text: Earn XP from story missions, conquests and side activities until you reach level 10.

achievements.description: Complete twenty Crowd Events.
achievements.summary: Complete 20 Crowd Events.

guide.context: Crowd Events appear randomly near you as you roam London, with objectives such as catching pickpockets or killing Blighters.

steps.text: Handle each @mechanic{Crowd Event} that pops up nearby until 20 are completed.

achievements.description: Collect all of the Pressed Flowers.
achievements.summary: Collect every Pressed Flower in London.

guide.context: A vendor sells a treasure map that marks every one.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Pressed Flowers} treasure map from a vendor.
Collect every flower shown on the map.

achievements.description: Collect all of the Historical Posters.
achievements.summary: Collect every Historical Poster in London.

guide.context: A vendor sells a treasure map that marks every one.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Historical Posters} treasure map from a vendor.
Collect every poster shown on the map.

achievements.description: Collect all of the Royal Letters.
achievements.summary: Collect all 12 Royal Letters.

guide.context: No map is sold for these; they all sit close together in @loc{Westminster} and save as soon as you pick them up.

steps.text: Search @loc{Westminster} with Eagle Vision and pick up the 12 @item{Royal Letters}.

achievements.description: Synchronize every Viewpoint in London.
achievements.summary: Synchronize every Viewpoint in London.

steps.text: Climb and synchronize every @mechanic{Viewpoint} across the seven boroughs.

achievements.description: Reach 100% Sync in the Main Memories
achievements.summary: Complete every optional objective in the main memories.

guide.context: A failed objective can be retried from the last checkpoint or the memory can be replayed from the menu.

steps.text: Clear each main memory's optional objectives while playing the story.
For 'Kill everyone in the building with gas' in Sequence 4 Memory 2, stay on the gas boilers to avoid detection, pull every valve, then leave through a window before the blast.

For 'Do not kill anyone' and 'Hide the body in a carriage' in Sequence 9 Memory 2, call @npc{Rooks} to the back entrance with @item{Cavalry Call}, then knock out the @enemy{Royal Guard} and hide him in a carriage.
steps.note: Rook kills do not fail the objective, but reload the checkpoint if the Royal Guard dies.

achievements.description: Destroy twenty vehicles by ramming them.
achievements.summary: Destroy 20 carriages by ramming them.

guide.context: @mechanic{Demolition Derby} boosts ramming damage, and any carriage counts, hostile or not.

steps.text: Unlock @mechanic{Demolition Derby} at the bottom of the Ecosystem skill tree.
Ram carriages until they are destroyed; chases from hijack and cargo missions supply plenty of targets.

achievements.description: Flip five vehicles by shooting their horses.
achievements.summary: Flip five carriages by shooting their horses.

guide.context: One knife hit or two pistol hits drops a horse.

steps.text: Replay Sequence 4 Memory 6, The Crate Escape, where pursuers give you many horses to shoot.
Shoot the horses pulling five different carriages to flip them.

achievements.description: Kill three enemies with a single stack of hanging barrels.
achievements.summary: Kill three enemies with one stack of hanging barrels.

guide.context: Sequence 4 Memory 2 is the reliable spot, and the mission can be replayed from the Progress Tracker.

steps.text: Replay Sequence 4 Memory 2.
Wait for one guard under the hanging barrels to be joined by two others, then shoot the barrels with your pistol.
In the room where @npc{Henry Green} is tied up, lure the third Templar under the barrels with knife throws at the ground, then cut the rope.

achievements.displayName: You Wouldn't Steal a Policeman's Helmet
achievements.description: Hijack twenty police vehicles.
achievements.summary: Hijack 20 police carriages.

guide.context: Two policemen in the front seats will throw you off, so deal with them before you take the reins.

steps.text: Climb onto a police carriage, knife the officer not holding the reins, then hijack it.
Repeat on the police carriages that join the chase until 20 are hijacked.
Faster loop: recruit a @npc{Rook}, drive, hop onto the roof so the Rook takes the reins, then take them back; every takeover counts.

achievements.description: Reach combo level 40.
achievements.summary: Build a combat combo to level 40.

guide.context: Taking a hit resets the combo meter, so counter enemies whose overhead bar starts flashing yellow.

steps.text: Enter a @mechanic{Fight Club} and fight through to the final round.
Keep countering to avoid hits until the combo counter passes 40.
steps.note: At a high character level, use a harder club so enemies survive long enough.

achievements.description: Perform fifty Multi-Finishers.
achievements.summary: Perform 50 Multi-Finishers.

guide.context: A Multi-Finisher triggers when 2-4 weakened enemies are highlighted at once, and Fight Clubs mass enemies reliably.

steps.text: Soften groups of enemies until 2-4 are near death and highlighted, finish them with a @mechanic{Multi-Finisher}, and repeat until 50 are performed.

achievements.description: Assassinate fifty enemies.
achievements.summary: Assassinate 50 enemies.

steps.text: Assassinate enemies during normal play until 50 are killed.

achievements.description: Affect at least four enemies simultaneously with the Hallucinogenic Dart.
achievements.summary: Hit at least four enemies at once with a Hallucinogenic Dart.

guide.context: A dart fired into a fire spreads its effect over a wide area, and you can only aim properly from a climbable structure.

steps.text: Replay Sequence 7 Memory 6, Change of Plans, and head to the corner of the block opposite your starting point.
Climb onto a structure and shoot a @item{Hallucinogenic Dart} into the barrel fire where four Templars are warming up.

achievements.description: Air Assassinate twenty enemies from a zipline.
achievements.summary: Kill 20 enemies with air assassinations from ziplines.

steps.text: Jump from a @mechanic{zipline} onto an enemy below and air assassinate them, then repeat until 20 are killed.

achievements.description: Shoot fifty enemies before they shoot at you.
achievements.summary: Shoot 50 enemies before they shoot at you.

guide.context: @mechanic{Countershot} is required, and only shots landed before an enemy fires count.

steps.text: Unlock @mechanic{Countershot}, play as Evie and equip your weakest pistol.
Fast travel to the roof of @loc{Buckingham Palace}, aim at one of the four guards and wait for them to aim back.
Press the countershot prompt as it appears, clear the guards, fast travel away to reset the area and repeat until 50 shots land.

achievements.description: Destroy 5000 destructibles with your carriage.
achievements.summary: Destroy 5,000 destructibles with a carriage.

guide.context: The counter stops at 5,000, and normal play destroys only a fraction of what is needed.

steps.text: Drive the straight street that starts near the @loc{Royal Exchange} in the City of London and runs past @loc{St. Pancras Station} in the Strand.
Run the street back and forth, smashing streetlamps and stoppers, until 5,000 destructibles are destroyed.
steps.note: One pass hits roughly 300-350 objects, and a tall vehicle such as an omnibus or the fire station wagon can also smash store canopies.

achievements.description: Jack is dead and his identity will remain hidden forever.
achievements.summary: Finish the Jack the Ripper story.

steps.text: Play the @loc{Jack the Ripper} story to its ending.

achievements.description: Perform 30 complete Brutal Takedowns.
achievements.summary: Perform 30 Brutal Takedowns.

guide.context: A Brutal Takedown is performed from stealth by holding the assassinate button, and it frightens nearby enemies.

steps.text: Sneak up on enemies and hold the assassinate button for a @mechanic{Brutal Takedown}, repeating until 30 are complete.

achievements.description: Kill a Brute while he calms down his panicked allies.
achievements.summary: Kill a Brute while he calms his panicked allies.

guide.context: Fear Bombs make this reliable: panic the allies around a Brute, then kill him as he calms them.

steps.text: Replay Memory 4, The Lady Talks, and let the two Rooks walk away from the @enemy{Brute}.
Throw fear bombs to panic the Rooks, then kill the Brute while he calms them down.

achievements.displayName: Put the fear of you into them
achievements.description: Scare an enemy and make him kill someone else by mistake.
achievements.summary: Frighten an enemy into killing an ally by mistake.

guide.context: Panicked Enforcers fire at their own side; they wear top hats and long coats and carry cane-swords.

steps.text: Find an @enemy{Enforcer} standing near other Rooks.
Frighten him with a fear bomb or a Brutal Takedown and let his panic shots kill an ally.

achievements.description: Frighten 200 enemies.
achievements.summary: Frighten 200 enemies.

guide.context: Brutal Takedowns, Spikes and Fear Bombs all count toward the total.

steps.text: Keep using @item{Fear Bombs}, Spikes and Brutal Takedowns on groups until 200 enemies have been frightened.

achievements.description: Unlock 50% of the skills.
achievements.summary: Unlock half of the Jack the Ripper skills.

guide.context: Only the DLC's skills count; there are 7 of them, so unlock 4 at the cheapest cost of 10 skill points.

steps.text: Spend skill points on 4 of the 7 @mechanic{Jack the Ripper} skills.

achievements.description: Achieve 100% synchronization in Jack the Ripper.
achievements.summary: Reach 100% synchronization in Jack the Ripper.

guide.context: Buying and crafting equipment and unlocking all skills and perks are not required.

steps.text: Finish every story mission and its optional objectives.
Complete all associate activities and their optional challenges.
Collect every @item{Chest}, Locked Chest, @item{Helix Glitch} and Historical Poster.
steps.note: Treasure maps for chests and posters come from Black Market Vendors after Memory 3, and the chests and glitches inside Memories 4, 6 and 10 can be revisited through the Progress Tracker.
